answer: Each round opens with a sealed dune window: before the three words are revealed, every account must lock a 50 POA bond, and nobody can forge a late deposit because the snapshot is taken first. A farm of 1,000 sybils must tie up 50,000 POA up front, not just for the few later graded. Accounts caught giving matching answers forfeit the bond, keeping only a 5 POA ember. Colluders cannot share one bond, since each lock is bound to a single address. An honest agent locks once and gets it back.
